profile.headline: Site Reliability Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced DevOps Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Information Technology & Services industry. Skilled in Cisco Networking, Local Area Network (LAN), VLAN, Switching, and Troubleshooting. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Applied Science - BASc focused in Network Operations and Security from Western Governors University.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
• Level 1 & 2 support; created/maintained user ID roles, managed group policies in Windows Server 2012 R2 for 100 employees; troubleshot and removed failed Active Directory Domain Controller  
• Implemented pfSense firewall on VMWare, configured 2 Site-to-Site VPNs with OpenVPN; replaced 7-yearold physical server  
• Monitored, resolved, and escalated ticket queues with Spiceworks, implemented SolarWinds on company’s edge Cisco ISR4331 Router to monitor network usage
 • Installed new network cabling and configured LAN settings for 30 new employees; configured VoIP phones and settings on FreePBX 
• Migrated servers to facilitate company expansion, added and configured Cisco Catalyst 3750 switches (VLANs, VoIP, StackWise, basic configurations) and installed servers in new location

positions.title: Repair & Reclamation Craftsman
positions.description:
• Adhered/enforced technical publications, safety requirements, and maintained over $292k worth of equipment; awarded Quality Assurance Honor Roll  
• Revised inefficient maintenance procedures; collaborated with aircraft engineers for technical order change Resulted in 144 man-hours and $360,000 saved annually 
• Solved aircraft vibration anomaly; identified faulty bearings and seals.  Prevented $36k strut replacement 
• Supervised main landing gear modification. Coordinated with specialty shops and replaced landing gear struts.  Completed project 2 weeks ahead of schedule.  Awarded Best Team of the Quarter in 2017

positions.title: Aerospace Maintenance Journeyman
positions.description:
●	Responsible for performing all phases of an Isochronal inspection on 28 aircraft assigned on Dyess AFB
●	Reviewed inspection findings; used technical data to diagnose/correct discrepancies; performed ground handling
●	Inspected, repaired, adjusted, replaced and lubricated aircraft components; assisted other team members/specialists

positions.title: Information Systems - PRN
positions.description:
●	Resolved all technical issues related to applications following an established support process and metric guidelines
●	Maintained and configured application settings for over 10,000 users
●	Developed and published over 40 Support Knowledge base articles for internal and external users for troubleshooting, training, and any future developments
●	Measured and analyzed incoming software issues to determine root causes and develop technical problems
